name: Front-to-Back Volume Rendering
aliases: Direct Volume Rendering with Front-to-Back Ray Casting
definition: A rendering process for semi-transparent volumes that mimics front-to-back additive blending, accumulating color and opacity along a ray.
summary: Front-to-Back Volume Rendering is a direct technique that accumulates color and opacity from front to back, distinguished by enabling early ray termination when accumulated opacity is high.
